prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: game decoration texture source, BACK orthographic view, albedo painting.
Create exactly one 1024 x 1024 transparent PNG by painting ONLY the surface of the supplied guide_back.png.
Inputs, in order: (1) guide_back.png is the EDIT TARGET and absolute authority for geometry, silhouette, camera, framing and alpha; (2) design_reference.png is the approved authority for design, colours and materials ONLY; (3) concept_crop.png is supporting original concept reference.
The edit target shows three broken segments of a fallen hive spire: a tall spiky segment on the left, a squat middle segment and a tapered low segment on the right. This is the BACK view of that exact model.
Geometry lock: retain the guide's EXACT pixel silhouette and transparent mask, all three pieces' positions, scale, spacing, outlines, every spike, notch, broken edge, opening and surface-shape edge. Retain the entire 1024 square canvas including its large empty transparent margins. The occupied bounds in this guide are approximately x=66..957, y=283..740; do not enlarge, reframe, rotate, crop, rearrange or fill the gaps. Do not copy the design reference's three-quarter camera or its different silhouette. Do not add geometry, new spikes, rubble, holes or appendages. Keep geometric edges registered to the guide.
Paint the design reference's materials onto the exact guide shapes: rich glossy black-violet organic resin and chitin, restrained plum-violet shell plates and organic ribs; weathered warm ivory bone on the existing spikes and bone ridges; dim glowing orange material inside the visible hollow broken ends and subtle orange sacs or seams where applicable to the existing shape. Use the reference's fine bone striation, chitin grain and restrained wear as surface colour detail. Surface patterning must not change geometry or transparency.
LIGHTING: THIS IS ALBEDO, a texture source, not a beauty render. Flat, even, shadowless illumination from the viewer over every surface. No directional shading, cast shadows, ambient-occlusion darkening, strong specular highlights, reflections, rim light, gradients caused by illumination, or cinematic contrast. Represent glossy material by its intrinsic material colour/detail, without baking specular lighting. Orange glowing regions are painted orange, with no bloom, halo or light cast on surrounding materials.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, exactly preserving the guide's background and spaces. No background colour, floor, ground plane, cast shadow, text, border or watermark. Deliver at native 1024 x 1024; no resizing. The unchanged guide geometry and alpha take precedence over decorative detail.
reason: Rejected: copied the three-quarter design reference rather than preserving the back guide geometry; strong lighting and highlights remain. One corrective regeneration will prioritize the guide. Native return is 1254 x 1254, not the requested 1024 x 1024.
